We can do this.

We can only guarantee a safe delivery to members when they're located in the Black Citadel, Divinity's Reach, the Grove, Hoelbrak, Lion's Arch, or Rata Sum.
We can take you to any of the dungeons from here. Where are you headed?
We can use the extractors and finish what someone else started here.
We can't all be valiants.
We can't change what was, only what will be.
We can't have a wild broodmother in the lab. It's a safety issue. Exterminate it!
We can't hold them. We must retreat, now!
We can't lose the castrum! As long as Tacitus or I remain standing, the Flame Legion will not regain control.
We can't protect everyone from this poison in the air. Get out for now.
We can't stop them! The tower won't hold!
We cannot balance the scales of the world when we ourselves are unbalanced. I will help us to regain our footing as a people.
We could launch the assault early.
We could stop sending them fish. See what happens.
We could sure use some help getting the sensors operational.
We could use some extra protection as we collect spikeroot fruit from Sandycove Beach. Any chance you'd be willing to help?
We could use your help. The garrison has weapons, and we need them.
We deal only in the finest tengu craftsmanship.
We destroyed the abomination, but it left behind quite a following. We have to get rid of that undead horde.
We did it! We killed them all!
We did it! Wooo!
We did it. We held strong!
We did it—we found a Dragon's Eye! Isn't it extraordinary? And heavy, too. Maybe that's because it's so powerful.
We didn't have it preinspected?
We discovered ruins with impressive treasure just floating around. Help us salvage some of it, and you'll get a fair share.
We do not forget a friend.

We don't actually make the history, but I get your point.
We don't have time for this. My friend is in that sick lich's hands. I have to help her!
We don't know that they want to hurt us. Control yourself.

We failed. They fled!
We fall back for now, but the dredge people will thrive against all enemies!

We fight as one!

We fight every day just to hold Tuyere Command Post and maintain solid footing in this region. We have to deal with direct assaults, as well as hit-and-run raids. Tar in our cistern puts off gas that harms the troops, making them weak and listless. We also have an auxiliary camp to the west at Severed Breach, but our control there is tenuous. It's a daily struggle, but someday we'll extinguish the Flame Legion, once and for all.
We fight together!

We fled oppression and warfare, only to find ourselves trapped in this gorge. We've been able to take refuge in this abandoned Zephyrite settlement, but there's precious little in the way of resources or defenses here.

We flew in here as conquerers, but Mordremoth reached up and tore us out of the sky. During the day, we tried to establish a foothold, but now we're just hoping to survive the night by setting up and defending rally points.
We get closer to finding Zinn's tomb with every day that passes.
We got all the finest exotic delicacies, just like you're in Amnoon! What'll you have?
We had fun at the hot springs, mm? Scared all those men away with our bathing suits.

We have a lot of estates and farm villages located in Diessa Plateau that provide a critical service to the legions. Trouble is, we're under constant assault by Separatists and ghosts. Our soldiers fight tooth and nail to keep these nuisances at bay, but it's a never-ending battle. They would appreciate any support you can give.
We have a lot of new people that have come in for the party.
We have a lot of new people who have come in for the party.
We have a race starting soon. Would you like to join in?
We have a taker! Those of you on the sidelines, pay attention! Maybe you'll learn something.
We have a tradition. We write about our pain and other emotions to be done with them. You'll find journals around, of various kinds. Reading them might give you insight into us.
We have a two-time winner, spectators! Let's raise the stakes! Place your bets! It's sylvari versus...wait for it...quaggan!
We have a winner! Next, you face Roomperoo the Terrible, scourge of the seas!

We have an especially unruly group of Sons of Svanir on our hands. They come down from their northern camp to attack and pillage the Snow Leopard shrine, and cause all sorts of trouble for the lodge in Snowslide Ravine, and the grawl in Graupel Kohn. Those grawl are friendly, and they don't deserve that grief. If you have time, we'd appreciate your help.
We have many beasts now! We will train and become strong.
We have our orders. Smash the weapons racks, lure the centaurs in, and wipe 'em out.
We have strong pets! Our strength is great!
We have the skritt test subjects isolated in containment pods below.
We have to hold out a little longer! It's almost ours.
We have to keep going. Get back to the keep.
We have to sleep eventually. My energy is down to about ten percent.
We have to stop them all!
We have? I mean, of course we have! I knew this was a worthwhile trip.
We hear a Forged ambusher's been getting the drop on travelers. Get him before he gets you.
We held on, thank the Spirits.
We held the line south of Lion's Arch. What's different now?
We in the Priory are dedicated to preserving, sharing, and utilizing knowledge. I will gladly share what I know with you.
We just need to hold on until daybreak in case there are any stragglers.
We just need to hold this rally point until help arrives!
We know not when these Elder Dragons came to be, only when we became aware of their awakening.
We know so little.
We light these candles to honor our fallen king.
We live in dangerous times.
We made it! Thanks for your help. This relic belongs in a museum.
We may be outfought, but we will never be beaten!
We may be well-fortified and well-supplied here, but we're also far from the fight, and that doesn't sit well with everyone.
We meet.
We might be in over our heads, but with the Light of Deldrimor? That's a different story altogether.
We must all stand against wrongdoing.
We must base our choices always on reality, and our senses are the only method we possess to perceive it.
We must fight to our last! Clear the area!
We must hold the garrison at all costs!
We must hurry. Watch your back.
We must learn the ways of our new home. Learning to build harmony in these lands will help us to build a new, landbound sanctuary.
We must move quickly if we are to beat the spider to our fly.
We must reach Faolain and stop her.
We must speak to the high priestess! We have proof that the champions are being killed and turned into undead.
We must work together!
We need a ley line!
We need a minute. Hold on.
We need all the help we can get to fight the Mordrem.
We need all the help we can get.
We need extra firepower at the bridge! We take it, we'll take the Flame Legion base.
We need help. Regroup!
We need more mortars. Grab a seed and help out.
We need more supplies.
We need more time, agent. This isn't simply a matter of installing an hourglass.
We need more troops, and then we'll set off.
We need reinforcements! Our camp's under attack by ghosts!
We need someone new in the kitchens.
We need to collect and decontaminate artifacts, deal with the Inquest in our camp, and...ahhh, the skimmers, too.
We need to cross the magma fields to find magmacyte. I've got a handy device that you can use to put out those fires.
We need to cut off the head of the Flame Legion. That would be Gaheron Baelfire.
We need to destroy the ley-line siphons—do that and we can break the connection to the dragons!
We need to find another way over.
We need to free these prisoners, and then find out where the squad leader was taken.
We need to get across here. With the proper ingredients, I could grow a new bridge.
We need to get his attention somehow...
We need to get in, but the entrance is guarded. If they raise an alarm, the operation is over before it begins.
We need to get in. Let's persuade the guards to let us apply a bit of Kaboomium to the door.

We need to keep our supply lines open to hold our positions in the wastes. Our pack animals are under constant threat of Mordrem ambush as they make their way through the canyons to and from Camp Resolve.
We need to keep that door open.
We need to make sure the area is secure from the Mistburned. Volunteers, please.
We need to stop Eir from shaking the hornet's nest.
We need to whip these Awakened into fighting shape!
We never saw them coming. They killed some of our soldiers and took the rest hostage. We need to find them.
We never worried too much about food or security under King Joko. But recently there have been a lot of suspicious things happening—the villagers are unhappy, and the Awakened are acting strange.
We only have a limited amount of time to collect those crystals.
We persevere.
We raid?
We really appreciate the help you gave us in dealing with those thieving skritt. Without their shiney things and our weapons, they're a mighty confused bunch of rodents.

We really have our hands full around here. Between fighting the Risen, the destroyers, and the Inquest, it's surprising we manage anything else. A local asura lab has been working on some new golems to help out, but they keep running out of power supplies. Some new weapons are being tested against the Risen, too, but it's slow going with only two people working on them. If you're up to helping out, it'd be welcome.
We really need to get you out of here right now.
We respect all but answer only to our own. We are the unbreakable wall to shelter the innocent, the unstoppable arrow to pierce the enemy, the unsuppressed voice of support and resistance.
We seem to be outnumbered.
We serve the queen.
We shall find the right tool and drive the point home.
We shall return!
We shall work very hard to live up to this gift.
We should be done in a few minutes, so long as we don't have any more interruptions.
We should be off. Zojja may be in trouble.
We should burn the damn jungle to the ground.
We should feast like that every night!
We should get Eir and the others. Get their help.
We should get as far away as we can.
We should have heard from Brugh by now. Oh, why did he go alone?
We should locate Zojja as quickly as possible.
We should recruit the Gear warband.
We should retreat!
We should settle it now. Now talk with us, decide which beast is the biggest danger, then speak to Shrill Sunderbark about a course of action.
We showed them. Take care now.
We skritt grow smarter when we are together. That's why it was vital for Tchkik's scouts to be rescued. The greater the numbers, the better the results.
We stand and fight. However, those who wish to leave may do so with the young and old.
We think they might have a camp nearby, although we aren't sure just yet. Keep your eyes peeled. We've seen them lurking around the lake and suspect they may tamper with it.
We think we've found Nephus, but we need to scout the area first. Draw their attention away for a bit longer.

We took this camp from the centaurs, but it's just a start. We got plans to rush their camps in the north. We're also going to deal them some real damage with their own catapults—from this side of the river.
We tore ourselves to ribbons, scrabbling for glory. Now, we bicker over mere scraps.
We travel—I mean traveled—the world in ships held aloft by the Aspects of Wind, Sun, and Lightning, seeking sanctum from the violence of life on land.
We use them to keep the sweet animals of the jungle healthy. And occasionally, a human or norn will come through covered with jungle fly bites. Poor things.
We used runestones to fortify the vault—to keep our enemies out. I can activate them for you.

We used to control the lands this far north, but with the peace talks, we've pulled back and allowed the humans to settle here. Rosko's Campsite, one of the new settlements, needs assistance if it's going to survive. Should it fail, it'll mean trouble for the treaty. If that wasn't enough, a number of charr have defected and created a warband devoted to stopping the peace process at all costs. I'll tell you this, this treaty better be worth the hassle.

We usually have a steady stream of traders out of Annwen coming through the haven, but I haven't seen any recently. I wonder if something's happened. They have a pretty aggressive hylek tribe as neighbors...
We want to pirate. On water. Need ship. Must build ship. We sell the shinies, get ship, be true pirates.

We welcome you as we have welcomed the unfortunate fallen from the sky. Our desire and duty is to aid them wherever we can. Our tribe tends a sacred oasis and protects it from invading threats. Lately, however, we are seeing an incursion of hostiles who call themselves Inquest. Also, something is attracting the Mordrem to our region. My advice to you? Be wary of dust twisters, stay clear of the "queen of the skritt," and be well.
We were attacked by a deranged centaur. We barely made it out alive!
We were attacked by bandits, and I was taken captive. Luckily, some adventurers came to my aid. Our move to Lion's Arch has been put on hold, but at least we're safe.
We were born to call you "mother." The others look to you for protection. Guidance. They follow like livestock.
We were digging when they blindsided us. Twenty of my miners are dead, and the dredge took the rest away. Those miners are my family! I need to get them back.
We were sure they'd work us to death.
We were there when the Pact fleet was overwhelmed. Mordremoth's minions were everywhere! Our airship crashed with the rest...and here we are.
We will bury the quiet ones.
We will come to the Pact camp and join the assault shortly.
We will consume you.
We will continue this later.
We will hold this rally point until our backup gets here!
We will live in accordance with the eight virtues: valor, humility, honor, honesty, justice, compassion, sacrifice, and loyalty.
We will meet again.
We will never surrender! Never!
We will never yield!
We will not be stopped! Golem! Initiate plan Alpha!
We will not be undone.
We will present incriminating documents and sworn testimony from respected members of the community, including the accused's own sister.
We will rend your flesh. Your spirits will join us.
We will return, with greater numbers!
We will succeed, and we will dominate!
We willingly give our magic to your champion. May the voice of Jormag always be clear to us!
We won!
We won't find it standing here. On to the next one.
We worked hard to wreck that camp. No way we're just going to let them rebuild it.
We'll break through the door with this abandoned carrier.
We'll chat after the fight, cub. Now secure that tower!
We'll deal with the big guy while you clear the room.
We'll destroy you as you destroyed us!
We'll draw the attention of any Orrians and thin out their numbers as we proceed. Let's all rendezvous at the far end of the site.
We'll eat soon. Don't give up.
We'll figure it out as we go.
We'll find her.
We'll get reinforcements over to you immediately.
We'll get you patched up. Just try to relax.
We'll grind them into the ground, brother!
We'll have our revenge!
We'll have our vengeance!
We'll have them back on their feet in no time. Thank you.
We'll have to make it happen with the troops we have. Move 'em out!
We'll have your blood.
We'll head for the Renegades' camp, and attack with all the force we can muster. Good choice, Recruit.
We'll hold them off the best we can!
We'll keep this one quiet.
We'll march soon. I promise.
We'll meet again.
We'll need a few moments to begin the disabling process.
We'll never forget you. They can't fly and they can't sing, but they're still my babies.
We'll pull them out by the roots!
We'll settle this later.
We'll take everything from you. Even your lives.
We'll take it from here, soldiers. Hold this entrance in case we need to retreat.
We'll tear this wall down brick by brick!
We'll work with what we've got. And we'll win. We have to.
We'll... (ahem) I'll find her.
We're Ash Legion. We keep our blades sharp and our minds sharper, always ready to go after the strongest enemies of the legion.
We're all accounted for and ready to go!
We're all clear! Let's get moving!
We're all here and ready to go.
We're all here. Let's head out!
We're all scared. But you say he's kind. He listens. Communication is key.
We're all starving. And working with the Jade Brotherhood only makes it worse.
We're almost ready to begin our mission. Don't go anywhere.
We're almost ready to humiliate the hylek. We just need a few more disposable agents to ensure victory.
We're almost there, Lyhr. Just hold on!
We're almost to the oasis camp.
We're as strong as you are.
We're as strong as you.
We're being overwhelmed at the south gate!
We're close to defeat! Don't let a single one survive!
We're close to their camp.
We're comparing notes with our team at Thunder Ridge Camp, and already we have some compelling findings.
We're doing our best to construct watchtowers and establish a perimeter.
We're done here!
We're done here. We should check on the others.
We're driving the grawl out of here, but they aren't leaving without a fight.
We're escorting the golem to supply Pact outposts all over the northern peninsula.
We're finished here!
We're gathering troops for the initial push even as we speak.
We're getting close. Keep moving!
We're getting destroyed down here!
We're getting you out of here!
We're going after her. She's causing trouble, and I don't want anyone dying because of her foolishness.
We're going to collapse a portion of Windloss Delves to keep the skritt from attacking the lumbermill. It's a sketchy plan, but as long we can get past any skritt defenders, it should work.
We're going to do this. We're going to be all right.
We're going to kick this hornet's nest to see what comes buzzing out. And if it's Cargiss, we're going to use that chugger to swat him down hard. Clear?
We're going to need heroes to take this thing down.
We're going to need weapons to rise up against the clanmarshal, and the only place we're going to find real weapons is in the garrison. You'll need keys from the Awakened guards patrolling the area.
We're going to pick up an iron shipment down at Scourgejaw's Vault. We could use some extra muscle on this run.
We're going to take the fight straight to the Flame Legion temple. I'm ready to fire whenever Legionnaire Harrownight gives the order. I can't wait!
We're gonna use it to lure a bear into the house. I heard if you do it right, you can fight a bear. You ever fight a bear?
We're happy to provide whatever help we can to win this war.
We're heading south to the old Jade Brotherhood base. Who's with us?
We're heating up...
We're here to help the sylvari and asura, to hopefully enlist them for the coming conflict against the Elder Dragons. More recently we've been focused on the breach in the mountains to the west.
We're holding off the Flame Legion assaults, but I got three scouts all begging for extra forces. Whaddya know—here they are now.
We're in jail!
We're in the midst of preparing for a roller beetle race! Your patience is appreciated. In the meantime, you can practice with a time trial lap or two.
We're just...temporarily inconvenienced. They're going to dig our homes out for us soon, you'll see.
We're literally going to get to the bottom of this.
We're long past excuses, Ryland. You made your choice. This needs to end.
We're looking for Soul Binders here—a kind of magical chain that can ensnare Branded. If you have any to spare, it would be a great help.
We're looking for eager skyscale riders to train our cadets for the fight ahead!
We're making good progress.
We're making progress! Oh and you've got...you've got some chitin on your face.
We're marching up to this place they call Incendio Templum. It's their HQ in this region, and we're going to kick them out of it. It's got great Flame-whumping potential. Wanna come?
We're moving out soon!
